payload.name: AI4F Japanese Study
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: AI4F Japanese Study helps learners explore Japanese vocabulary, kanji, and grammar through interactive lookup, flashcards, quizzes, matching games, and radical puzzles. This version provides public learning content and does not require account linking.
payload.longDescription: AI4F Japanese Study 通过互动查询、抽认卡、测验、配对游戏和部首谜题，帮助学习者探索日语词汇、汉字和语法。此版本提供公开学习内容，无需关联账号。

payload.name: TapWaterMap
payload.description: US tap water quality by city
payload.summaryOriginal: US tap water quality by city
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: TapWaterMap shows US tap-water quality city by city, using the EPA's own Safe Drinking Water Information System (SDWIS) records. Look up the water systems serving a city, the contaminants and violations on record — with dates and whether the EPA classifies each as health-based — compare cities side by side, and understand what any contaminant is. It's calm and sourced: it reports what the EPA recorded and never gives a safety verdict. Covers about 19,000 cities across all 50 states and DC.

payload.name: Omphalis
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Omphalis is the place where what you read, hear, and note begins to cohere. You save an article, and Omphalis shows its structure. You listen to a podcast on your commute, and Omphalis helps you come back to what mattered. You watch a two-hour talk, and Omphalis shows you the shape of it in seconds. You record a voice note at midnight, and Omphalis places it beside the article, talk, or paper that belongs with it.

The paper you read last spring meets the book you are reading now, and your voice note from a walk last month sits beside both. What changed in the field, what changed in your understanding, what still holds: all part of the same library, still in reach, still connected. Not a pile that grows heavier. A place that gets clearer.

It is for people who need what they consume to stay usable later — in writing, teaching, decision-making, research, or reflection — where understanding can compound over time.

Omphalis is a companion for long content: a map for structure, a margin for meaning, and a way back to the moments that matter.

payload.name: MSDS Chain
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: MSDS Chain brings chemical safety intelligence into ChatGPT. Ask about any chemical and get instant, sourced answers: pairwise compatibility, GHS hazards and H-codes, PPE, storage and isolation rules, safe mixing order, waste disposal, occupational exposure limits, UN transport classification, and multi-region regulatory compliance (23 watch lists across 11 regions). Upload an MSDS/SDS PDF to extract structured safety data, or generate an Ed25519-signed audit report for GLP/GMP records. Built for researchers, lab managers, and EHS teams who design experiments with AI and need safety verification in the same conversation. Powered by ChainSDS, a verified, continuously updated chemical safety database.

payload.name: Nylon
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Nylon gives ChatGPT direct access to primary legal source material across New Zealand, Australia and the UK — legislation, case law and commentary (including government guidance) — so answers to legal and tax questions are grounded in real, current sources.
Ask a question in plain language and Nylon runs keyword and semantic searches across the library. It handles precise lookups, as well as open research. 
Every result carries citation links to the original, so you can verify what you're reading and cite it with confidence. Nylon is built for lawyers, tax advisers and anyone who needs trusted and meticulous legal research.
payload.longDescription:
Nylon 让 ChatGPT 直接访问新西兰、澳大利亚和英国的主要法律资料，包括法规、判例法和评论（含政府指南），使法律和税务问题的答案基于真实、当前的来源。
用自然语言提问，Nylon 会在资料库中进行关键词和语义搜索，既能处理精确查找，也能开展开放式研究。
每个结果都带有指向原文的引用链接，你可以核实所读内容并自信引用。Nylon 面向律师、税务顾问及任何需要可靠、严谨法律研究的人。

payload.name: Skarim!
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Skarim provides access to publicly available Israeli polling data.

Users can explore recent polls, compare political parties, and view trends over time based on published sources.

The app is read-only and for informational purposes only. It does not provide political advice, election predictions, campaign recommendations, or voter persuasion.

All data is aggregated from publicly published polling results.

payload.name: TaxMCP
payload.description: 带引证的美国税务研究
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
TaxMCP gives ChatGPT citation-grounded access to U.S. tax authority. It searches and retrieves the Internal Revenue Code, Treasury Regulations, IRS publications and guidance, selected state tax statutes, and U.S. Tax Court opinions.

Seven read-only research tools support broad tax-law search, direct section lookup, IRS publication and guidance retrieval, Tax Court opinion retrieval, case citation-activity research, and statutory cross-reference analysis. Results include source identifiers and citation URLs so users can inspect the underlying authority.

TaxMCP is built for CPAs, enrolled agents, tax attorneys, researchers, and others who need source-linked tax research inside their existing AI workflow. It does not file returns, submit forms, make payments, edit records, or provide legal or tax advice. Case citation activity is not a substitute for Shepard's, KeyCite, or another authoritative current-validity check.
payload.longDescription:
TaxMCP 让 ChatGPT 能够访问美国税务权威资料，并为答案提供引证依据。它可搜索并检索《国内税收法典》、财政部条例、IRS 出版物和指导文件、部分州税法，以及美国税务法院判决。

七种只读研究工具支持广泛的税法搜索、直接查询法条、检索 IRS 出版物和指导文件、检索税务法院判决、研究案件引证情况，以及分析法条交叉引用。结果包含来源标识符和引证 URL，方便用户查看相关权威资料。

TaxMCP 面向注册会计师（CPA）、注册代理人（EA）、税务律师、研究人员及其他希望在现有 AI 工作流程中进行带来源链接的税务研究的人。它不会申报纳税申报表、提交表格、付款、编辑记录，也不提供法律或税务建议。案件引证情况不能替代 Shepard's、KeyCite 或其他权威的现行有效性核查。

payload.name: AL WAKEELO
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: AL WAKEELO is your digital legal assistant that searches 600,000+ Pakistani case laws and statutes, drafts petitions and commercial contracts, and conducts deep legal research.
payload.longDescription: AL WAKEELO 是你的数字法律助手，可搜索600,000+项巴基斯坦判例和成文法，起草诉状和商业合同，并开展深入的法律研究。

payload.name: Premom Ovulation Calculator
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Premom Ovulation Calculator helps users estimate an ovulation day, fertile window, next period, and when to begin LH ovulation test strips from the first day of the last period and average cycle length. It opens an interactive educational calculator in ChatGPT and supports English, German, and Simplified Chinese. The app does not connect to a Premom account, sell products, or direct users to an external website. Results are cycle-based educational estimates and are not a substitute for professional medical advice.

payload.name: Flashcards Space
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Flashcards Space helps you create language flashcards directly inside ChatGPT.

Ask ChatGPT to generate flashcards for any topic or language pair, and they are saved to your Flashcards Space account — ready to review with spaced repetition on iOS app.

What you can do:
- Create flashcards in any language pair and organize them into decks
- Edit flashcard front/back text after creation
- Delete flashcards that you just created

All flashcards sync to the Flashcards Space mobile app (iOS), where you practice with spaced repetition to maximize long-term retention.

payload.name: Life Analytics IAS
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Life Analytics IAS is the integrated analysis support system from Life Analytics for research teams. This ChatGPT app lets authorized users review IAS experiment records, analysis summaries, and report context from their workspace. It is read only, returns summarized research context only, and does not provide raw file export, personal data, diagnosis, treatment decisions, or clinical advice.

payload.name: PGA – Play Golf
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Get personalized coaching from a PGA of America Golf Professional, whose expertise and on-course insight helps you understand your game more clearly and improve where it matters most. Find a golf coach matched to your goals, skill level, location, and schedule.

Use this app to compare coach offerings, view their availability, and book a lesson that fits your schedule. Online tips and videos can help, but taking a lesson with the right coach is the most effective way to make lasting improvements and play better golf with confidence.

payload.name: Linked Word
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Linked Word looks up King James passages, Strong's Hebrew and Greek numbers, English-to-Strong's reverse lookups, verses that use a number, KJV full-text search, and named section headings (topics) by keyword or meaning. Passage results are the text plus a citation URL unless Strong's word links are requested.

payload.name: SRS (Spaced Repitation System)
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
SRS (Spaced Repetition System) is a personal learning and revision app designed to help users retain knowledge for the long term instead of forgetting it after a few days. It lets users organize content into subjects and topics, store detailed lessons, summaries, notes, coding examples, and reference links, and mark topics as either "to learn" or "learned." Once a topic is learned, the app automatically schedules future reviews using a spaced repetition algorithm based on the user's confidence and previous performance.

The app is aimed at students, software developers, and lifelong learners, with a strong focus on technical subjects such as DSA, programming, algorithms, and interview preparation. Each day, it generates a personalized review queue so users know exactly what to revise, helping them strengthen their understanding over time while spending less time reviewing concepts they already know well. The goal is to serve as a personal knowledge base and long-term memory system that makes learning more efficient and consistent.

payload.name: Beast Academy - All Ten
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
All Ten – Beast Academy is a daily math puzzle families can solve together. Using only basic math operations and each of the four digits provided in the puzzle, your goal is to create every number from 1 through 10.

The challenge reflects Beast Academy’s approach to building number sense and problem-solving skills through playful, thought-provoking puzzles rather than rote practice.

With the ChatGPT app, the experience goes a step further. When families get stuck, they can use the conversational nature of AI to ask for hints, explore strategies, and work through ideas together without simply revealing the answers. It’s a simple, engaging way to turn math time into shared discovery and get a feel for Beast Academy’s problem-solving philosophy.

Think of it as Wordle, but for mathematical thinking.
payload.longDescription:
All Ten – Beast Academy 是一个家庭可以一起解答的每日数学谜题。只使用基本数学运算，并使用题目给出的全部四个数字，你的目标是构造从 1 到 10 的每个数。

这项挑战体现了 Beast Academy 的理念：通过有趣、启发思考的谜题培养数感和解决问题的能力，而不是机械练习。

ChatGPT 应用让体验更进一步。当家人遇到困难时，可以利用 AI 的对话能力寻求提示、探索策略、一起推敲想法，而不是直接揭晓答案。这是一种简单且引人投入的方式，将数学时间变成共同探索，并体会 Beast Academy 的解题理念。

可以把它想象成锻炼数学思维的 Wordle。

payload.name: Digital Compass
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: When someone clicks a fake link, loses an account or gets scammed online, generic advice is not enough — they need the exact steps and the real reporting channels for their country. Digital Compass provides curated crisis playbooks (what to do NOW, what NOT to do, how to report) and prevention guides in 9 languages (Romanian original; English/Hungarian anchored in Romania; Polish, Czech, Slovak, Italian, French, German anchored in their own countries with local authorities: police, CERT, consumer protection). Every playbook exposes its last-verified date. Free, no account, no ads; content licensed CC BY 4.0.

payload.name: SimpleFeed News & Video MCP
payload.description: 已获授权的新闻与视频内容
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: The SimpleFeed News & Video Content Marketplace brings rights-cleared content into OpenAI. Search hundreds of premium publishers by topic, outlet, publisher, metadata date and more. Get article summaries, full text, images and video in HTML, markdown and vectors for inference and grounding. The App brings SimpleFeed Paid MCP servers for semantic article search and publisher discovery.  Purchase query based access via a click-to-accept license with your AWS account. Sign in with OAuth after subscribing to save tokens, be rights compliant, and improve your App.
payload.longDescription: SimpleFeed 新闻与视频内容市场将已获授权的内容带入 OpenAI。按主题、媒体、出版方、元数据日期等条件搜索数百家优质出版商。获取文章摘要、全文、图片和视频，格式包括 HTML、markdown 和用于推理与内容依据的向量数据。此应用提供 SimpleFeed 付费 MCP 服务器，用于语义文章搜索和出版商发现。通过点击接受许可的方式，使用你的 AWS 账户购买按查询计费的访问权限。订阅后通过 OAuth 登录以保存令牌、确保符合内容授权要求并改进应用。

payload.name: StraighterLine Degree Planner
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
StraighterLine Degree Planner helps you turn your goals into a realistic, actionable path to graduation.

Build your plan through a guided experience — set your degree level, major, weekly study time, budget, timeline, learning style, and school preferences. Instantly see a personalized, multi-phase roadmap with cost estimates, a realism score, and clear insights into what’s working, and what’s not.

You can test different scenarios, adjust in real time, and get practical recommendations to stay on track and graduate with confidence.

payload.name: Boluda
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Search Boluda.com courses, lessons, and podcast episodes, compare options, and create personalized study plans from the public catalog.
payload.longDescription: 搜索 Boluda.com 的课程、课时和播客单集，比较选项，并根据公开目录创建个性化学习计划。

payload.name: Skillsail
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Create engaging, interactive eLearning with Skillsail directly from ChatGPT. Turn ideas into polished courses with slides, quizzes, activities, images, videos, and voiceovers, then explore them in an interactive inline player and translate them for global audiences. When training is ready, share it as a link or reusable template, or export it as SCORM 1.2, SCORM 2004, xAPI, cmi5, or standalone HTML5.

payload.name: PhysioKeys
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: PhysioKeys helps clinicians, students, educators, and researchers search physiotherapy and rehabilitation evidence from ChatGPT. Users can search curated PhysioKeys records or PubMed, fetch article details, review abstracts and rights-verified cached full text when available, generate citations, view saved-article metadata, save PMIDs to their private library, and check account allowances. The plugin is intended only for de-identified research and citation workflows and may refuse requests containing patient-identifiable information. It does not provide emergency diagnosis or personalized medical advice.

payload.name: MentorCruise
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Find the right MentorCruise mentor without leaving your chat. Search 1,000s of vetted mentors by skill, budget, and response time, compare profiles, and get a booking link in seconds.

MentorCruise connects you with experienced mentors in tech, product, design, marketing, and leadership – right from your AI assistant.

Describe what you're working on and the assistant searches real MentorCruise mentors, ranked by rating and reviews. Filter by skill, industry, language, monthly budget, and how fast a mentor typically replies. Open any profile to see their background, what they offer, and pricing, then get a direct link to book a session or start ongoing mentorship.
payload.longDescription:
在聊天中查找合适的 MentorCruise 导师。可按技能、预算和响应时间搜索 1,000s

名经过审核的导师、比较资料并获取预订链接。支持科技、产品、设计、营销和领导力领域；可按技能、行业、语言、月预算和通常回复速度筛选，并查看背景、服务和价格，然后直接链接到

MentorCruise 预订课程或开始持续指导。费用信息见原文。

payload.name: EduInsights
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Research U.S. colleges, reported degrees, careers, pay, outlook, accreditation, and observed AI use. Every answer shows its sources.

payload.name: ZZAIM
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: ZZAIM helps teachers find Korean K-12 achievement standards, create and save curriculum-aligned lesson plans, and export saved documents as DOCX, PPTX, or HWPX files.

payload.name: Dhamma Data
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Search the Pāli canon and later textual layers, read selected translations by stable segment, inspect commentary and parallel coverage, compare held witnesses, trace concepts across declared strata, analyze bounded evidence sets, and cite every result to an openable source page.

payload.name: Protplex
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Protplex makes the Protein Data Bank searchable in natural language through distilled structural, functional, and biochemical profiles. It helps users search 240,000+ PDB structures across function, structure, chemistry, organism, assembly, ligands, and experimental context.
payload.longDescription:
该插件查找蛋白质结构。以下功能和限制适用：
Protplex makes the Protein Data Bank searchable in natural language through distilled structural, functional, and biochemical profiles. It helps users search 240,000+ PDB structures across function, structure, chemistry, organism, assembly, ligands, and experimental context.

payload.name: Vocabden
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Vocabden is your language-learning memory inside ChatGPT. Connect your account so ChatGPT can see what you're actually learning — your saved words, your level, and what's due for review — instead of starting from zero every conversation.

What it can do:
- Look up any word or phrase, with definitions and sentence-level analysis
- Save new words you come across while chatting
- Check how many words in a text you already know, so ChatGPT can pick material at your level
- Pull up your due words and review them right in the chat
- Record your review results so your spaced-repetition schedule stays accurate

Vocabden focuses on English and German vocabulary, with explanations in your own language. You'll need an existing Vocabden account (or create one for free) — guest sessions can't be connected. This app can't read your other ChatGPT conversations or change your account settings, and you can disconnect it anytime from your Vocabden profile.

payload.name: Lux AI
payload.description: 搜索 Lux Research 报告
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Lux AI puts Lux Research's curated analyst knowledge one question away. Ask about emerging technologies, companies, markets, and academic research, and get answers drawn from Lux's proprietary publications. Every claim carries a source citation linking back to the underlying research, so you go from question to a defensible, sourced answer in seconds. Requires an active Lux Research subscription with your organization.
payload.longDescription: Lux AI 让你只需提出一个问题，就能获取 Lux Research 精选的分析师知识。询问新兴技术、公司、市场和学术研究，获得来自 Lux 专有出版物的回答。每项主张都带有来源引用，链接回底层研究，让你在几秒内从问题得到可辩护、有来源的答案。需要你的组织拥有有效的 Lux Research 订阅。

payload.name: TTMNG Public
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: TTMNG Public lets people look up TTMNG terms and read public knowledge records in Thai, Spanish, and Italian. It keeps signal-point records separate from disease or condition records and states the educational evidence boundaries. It does not provide diagnosis or personalized treatment advice.

payload.name: Replio
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Replio is an AI voice training platform: trainees practice real conversations with lifelike AI personas in live voice sessions and receive scored feedback, while managers follow their progress.

This plugin lets you set up and run a Replio training project without leaving ChatGPT. 
Connect with your Replio account, or with an access code shared by a Replio manager, then:

  - Name and describe your training project
  - Add company knowledge: paste text and links, or upload documents through a secure page
  - Get training goal suggestions generated from your documents and adjust them
  - Generate AI training personas, then review and edit each one before going live
  - Build a knowledge quiz and pick the questions you want to keep
  - Activate the project and invite trainees
  - Check results afterwards: session KPIs and recent team activity

  Voice training sessions themselves take place on replio.eu, in 58 languages. Built in Europe, GDPR compliant, with EU data hosting.

payload.name: QuizStage
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: QuizStage helps users build and maintain quiz shows through ChatGPT. The app can list a user's own shows, inspect show structure, create new shows, edit show basics, manage categories, and create, update, reorder, or delete normal question cards.

payload.name: CoreStepPrep
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: CoreStepPrep helps medical students study inside ChatGPT using their CoreStepPrep question history, accessible question bank, CSPCE attempts, and score predictor data. Ask what to study next, explain a CoreStepPrep QID, check available questions for a topic, create a tutor quiz link, review CSPCE performance, or analyze score prediction trends. The app returns concise guidance and compact widgets so students can move from conversation to focused review quickly.
payload.longDescription: CoreStepPrep 帮助医学生在 ChatGPT 中使用 CoreStepPrep 的做题历史、可用题库、CSPCE 尝试记录和分数预测数据学习。询问接下来该学什么、解释 CoreStepPrep QID、查看某主题的可用题目、创建导师测验链接、复盘 CSPCE 表现或分析分数预测趋势。应用返回简洁指导和紧凑组件，让学生快速从对话进入聚焦复习。

payload.name: CAIRO Medicines
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: CAIRO Medicines looks up medicines authorised in the EU and the US and returns the regulator-published label text itself, with the product, document, section, source URL and date attached to every passage. Users can find a medicine by brand name or active ingredient, narrow a broad section to the specific warning they asked about, review the version history of a label, and find the official adverse-event reporting route for their jurisdiction. When a name matches more than one product it lists the candidates instead of choosing one, and for markets outside the EU and US it states the limitation rather than substituting another market's label.
payload.longDescription: CAIRO Medicines 查询欧盟和美国批准的药品，并返回监管机构发布的标签原文；每段文字都附有产品、文档、章节、来源 URL 和日期。用户可以按品牌名或活性成分查找药品，将宽泛章节缩小到所询问的具体警告，查看标签版本历史，并找到所在司法辖区的官方不良事件报告渠道。如果名称对应多个产品，它会列出候选项而不是擅自选择；对于欧盟和美国以外的市场，它会说明限制，不会用其他市场的标签替代。

payload.name: Powers Index
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
The Powers Index Guided Intelligence tool helps college and university leaders assess institutional performance using a structured framework of 12 signals covering areas such as governance, finance, operations, enrollment, and external conditions.

Users describe a challenge or question, and the app identifies relevant signals, highlights potential risks, and suggests considerations for action.

This tool is intended for decision-makers at colleges and universities involved in institutional oversight and planning.

This app does not provide legal, financial, investment, or accreditation advice.

payload.name: OpenRegs: Regulatory Research
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
OpenRegs brings current U.S. statutes and regulations into ChatGPT for compliance teams. Coverage spans 53 jurisdictions: all 50 states, D.C., Puerto Rico, and federal. Every answer returns the actual text of the law, along with a research log and public citation links that anyone can open, so a colleague or an auditor can check the work rather than take a summary on faith. Run a 50-state survey in one request instead of maintaining a spreadsheet by hand. Built by OpenLaws PBC, the public benefit corporation behind the OpenLaws API. OpenLaws is not a law firm and does not provide legal advice.

Use cases:
- Confirm a citation is real and still in force, then read its current text.
- Compare how a rule differs across multiple states in one request.
- Research a regulatory topic across U.S. statutes and regulations, with a research log and citations you can verify.

payload.name: Medeloop Grants
payload.description: Find and apply for NIH grants
payload.summaryOriginal: Find and apply for NIH grants
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Medeloop Grants helps researchers and program teams move from “What should we apply for?” to a credible first draft without switching tools or starting from scratch.
Inside ChatGPT, it combines curated grant data, your professional context, and purpose-built drafting workflows into a single experience. You can ask for relevant funding opportunities, quickly understand whether you’re a good fit, and begin drafting a proposal in the same conversation.
What makes it useful in practice is how the pieces connect. Instead of returning a long list of generic results, Medeloop matches grants to your background and research focus, helping you prioritize opportunities that are actually feasible. It also surfaces key constraints like eligibility and deadlines early, so you spend less time chasing grants that are unlikely to work.
When you’re ready to write, the platform guides you through structured inputs and generates a solid first-pass draft that you can refine. The drafting process builds on the same context used for discovery, so you don’t have to repeat yourself or reframe your work each time.
People tend to value Medeloop Grants because it reduces the overhead around grant work. It helps them focus on the substance of their research instead of navigating fragmented tools, reformatting information, or second-guessing fit. Over time, as it learns from your inputs and past work, it becomes more tailored to how you search and write.
The result is a more continuous workflow from discovery to draft, with less friction and fewer wasted cycles.

payload.name: Suplla
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: suplla helps logged-in learners check their English-study progress, browse grammar topics and vocabulary, practice personalized exercises, and report problems with learning data through ChatGPT.

payload.name: NoBrainner
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
NoBrainner connects your flashcard study progress and spaced repetition decks directly to ChatGPT. Once signed in, you can ask ChatGPT for a detailed overview of your current study stats, check your recent review activity, pinpoint your weakest cards, and get personalized recommendations on what to review next.

Additionally, you can use ChatGPT to instantly draft new study decks (such as vocabulary lists, practice questions, or topic summaries) and save them directly to your NoBrainner account after reviewing the draft.

payload.name: StudyArena
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Ask a study question once and compare multiple AI-generated answers side by side. StudyArena helps students explore explanations, writing feedback, research approaches, and assignment planning, then choose the answer they find most useful.

payload.name: Eclat Institute
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Search Eclat Institute exam notes, practical guidance, and tuition information.

payload.name: Special Education Law
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Search special education decisions and rulings, retrieve complete case records, explore citation relationships, analyze adjudicators and issue trends, and look up hearing procedures and regulations across multiple states.

payload.name: WordByWord – Learn Languages
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Learn languages by building and practicing vocabulary directly in ChatGPT. Create collections, add words and phrases with translations and example sentences, track your learning progress, and generate personalized exercises using the vocabulary you are still learning.

WordByWord supports 50+ languages and keeps your vocabulary organized in one place.

payload.name: Open Ephemeris
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Open Ephemeris gives ChatGPT real astronomy to work from. Every position comes from the NASA JPL DE440 ephemeris covering 1550-2650 CE at sub-arcsecond precision, the same kernel used for spacecraft navigation, so positions are computed rather than estimated.

Ask for a natal chart and an interactive wheel opens in the conversation. Click a planet, a house, or an aspect line and the interpretation loads in place. Switch house systems without asking again. The same applies to Human Design bodygraphs, synastry bi-wheels, transit timelines, Vedic Rashi grids and BaZi Four Pillars charts.

Beyond charts: transits and progressions, solar and lunar returns, eclipse timing and local visibility, astrocartography, electional search for timing windows, and fixed-star positions.

Free to start, no card required.

payload.name: AliXAi
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: AliXAi te donne accès, directement dans l'assistant, à ton espace personnel de connaissance de soi : thème astrologique, Human Design, Gene Keys, numérologie et astrologie géographique, plus tes transits du moment, ta phrase du jour, ton entourage et ta synastrie, et l'Académie (cours et webinaires). L'assistant lit et met en forme tes données déjà calculées, marque tes leçons ou t'inscrit à un webinaire ; les visualisations interactives et les actions sensibles (données de naissance, abonnement) restent dans l'app.
payload.longDescription: AliXAi 让你直接在助手中访问个人自我认知空间：占星星盘、Human Design、Gene Keys、数字命理和地理占星，以及当前行运、每日一句、身边的人及合盘，还有学院（课程和网络研讨会）。助手读取并整理已计算的数据、标记课程或为你报名网络研讨会；交互式可视化及敏感操作（出生数据、订阅）仍在应用内进行。

payload.name: Vocaneo
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Vocaneo connects ChatGPT to the French careers and training reference data: over 1,000 job profiles (missions, skills, salaries, labour-market tension, AI exposure), RNCP diplomas and certifications, and more than 135,000 training programmes with the establishments that deliver them across France.

Ask career questions in plain language: « how do I become a nurse in Lyon? », « I am a developer, which jobs could I move to? », « which jobs are hiring without long studies? ». ChatGPT queries the reference data, cross-references jobs, entry routes, training programmes and providers, and cites the matching public vocaneo.com page for every answer.

The connector is read-only, with no account and no configuration: the data served is the public data of vocaneo.com. It collects nothing and gives no individualised advice — it serves verifiable facts from the French national reference data (ROME 4.0, RNCP), kept continuously up to date.

Vocaneo is a French mission-driven company (SAS, ESUS-accredited) building career guidance tools on open data and psychometric assessment.
payload.longDescription:
Vocaneo 将 ChatGPT 接入法国职业和培训参考数据：涵盖 1,000 多种职业档案（工作任务、技能、薪资、劳动力市场紧缺程度、受 AI 影响程度）、RNCP 文凭和认证，以及法国各地超过 135,000 个培训项目及其提供机构。

你可以用日常语言提出职业问题，例如：“如何在里昂成为护士？”“我是开发人员，可以转做哪些工作？”“哪些工作招聘时不要求长期学习？”ChatGPT 会查询参考数据，交叉关联职业、入行途径、培训项目和提供方，并为每个回答引用对应的 vocaneo.com 公开页面。

此连接器为只读，无需账户或配置：所提供的数据均为 vocaneo.com 的公开数据。它不收集任何信息，也不提供个性化建议——只提供法国国家参考数据（ROME 4.0、RNCP）中的可核实事实，并持续更新。

Vocaneo 是一家法国使命驱动型公司（SAS，获 ESUS 认证），利用开放数据和心理测评构建职业指导工具。

payload.name: Contact Center AI Association
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: The Contact Center AI Association app enables members to find answers and register for meetings inside ChatGPT.  After connecting a CCAIA account, members can search CCAIA resources, member information, chapter details, policies, and procedures, register for events, and create a support ticket when a request needs human follow-up.
payload.longDescription: Contact Center AI Association 应用让会员能够在 ChatGPT 中查找答案并报名参加会议。连接 CCAIA 账户后，会员可以搜索 CCAIA 资源、会员信息、分会详情、政策和流程，报名参加活动，并在请求需要人工跟进时创建支持工单。

payload.name: Admit Coach University Finder
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Search 3,500+ U.S. colleges and universities by name, location, major, program, athletics, accreditation, deadlines, and cost. Compare schools side by side and review admissions, tuition, financial aid, graduation rates, and earnings directly in ChatGPT.
payload.longDescription: 按名称、地点、专业、课程项目、体育、认证、截止日期和费用搜索3,500+所美国学院和大学。直接在ChatGPT中并排比较学校，查看招生、学费、经济援助、毕业率和收入情况。

payload.name: Talents Kids
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Talents Kids is the premiere way to discover and cultivate your child's innate potential. By transforming everyday artifacts—like drawings, writings, and school projects—into deep talent insights, we help parents and educators understand exactly where a child shines. 

Our platform doesn't just analyze; it acts, generating personalized educational worksheets and creative coloring pages that turn talent discovery into a daily learning adventure. Whether you are tracking progress through earned achievements or exporting comprehensive talent reports, Talents Kids provides the tools you need to support your child's unique journey from the palm of your hand.

payload.name: Lucebra
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Search and discover online courses on Lucebra by topic, skill, or learning goal. Quickly explore relevant course options and find learning content that matches what you want to study.

payload.name: Wayroc Career Coach
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Improve Data and SDE resumes without inventing evidence, or match supplied plain-text resume content to today's public Wayroc job feed through one read-only action. No Wayroc account, OAuth, saved-resume access, job application, notification, or student-data modification is used.

payload.name: CiteCheck
payload.description: 核查引文，查找法律依据
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: CiteCheck helps users search a focused federal, California, and New York legal search, retrieve primary-source passages, check whether citations appear in covered sources, and practice courtroom objections. It does not determine good-law status or provide legal advice.
payload.longDescription: CiteCheck 帮助用户在范围明确的联邦、加利福尼亚州和纽约州法律资料中搜索，检索一手来源段落，检查引文是否出现在其覆盖的来源中，并练习法庭异议。它不会判断法律效力状态，也不提供法律意见。

payload.name: MedStats
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: MedStats verbindet ChatGPT mit dem persönlichen MedAT-Tracking. Nutzer können bestätigte Übungsergebnisse speichern, letzte Ergebnisse abrufen, Untertest-Trends analysieren, ihren Lernfortschritt zusammenfassen lassen, den Tagescoach nutzen, Planblöcke abhaken und ein Wochenreview mit nächsten Empfehlungen erhalten.

payload.name: TeX64
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: TeX64 turns course material into Japanese lecture notes, exam summaries, exercise sheets, and simple academic reports. Users describe the result in ordinary language; TeX64 handles typography and production details on its own server and returns a finished PDF with page previews. Compilation runs in a throwaway sandbox with no network access. PDF links are temporary and expire within the hour; TeX64 keeps no accounts or document history.

payload.name: UrbanPro Tutor Finder
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
UrbanPro Tutor Finder helps learners discover experienced tutors and coaching providers for academics, competitive exams, coding, languages, music, fitness, professional skills, and more. Simply describe what you want to learn, and the platform surfaces relevant tutor matches tailored to your preferences.

Whether you are looking for online classes, home tutors, or in-person coaching in your city, UrbanPro Tutor Finder makes it easy to explore options based on subject, budget, teaching mode, ratings, and experience.

What you can search for

• “Maths tutor for Class 10 CBSE in Bangalore”
• “Online IELTS coaching under ₹800/hour”
• “Home guitar teacher near me”


Key Features

• Search tutors using natural-language requests
• Discover both online and offline classes
• Explore tutors across 1,000+ learning categories
• Compare ratings, reviews, experience, and hourly fees
• Find tutors for school subjects, entrance exams, coding, languages, music, yoga, and more
• Access verified tutor profiles with direct links to continue on UrbanPro

Who it’s for

• Students preparing for exams like JEE, NEET, CAT, IELTS, UPSC, and more
• Parents searching for tutors for school students
• Working professionals learning coding, languages, or career skills
• Hobby learners exploring music, arts, dance, fitness, and personal interests

How it works

Enter what you want to learn in plain English
Receive tutor recommendations matched to your requirements
Open tutor profiles on UrbanPro to continue and connect directly

Notes

Tutor discovery happens within the app experience, while booking and further interactions take place on UrbanPro.

payload.name: PE Prep Pro Engineering
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: PE Prep Pro Engineering helps PE candidates create reviewed practice sets, grade completed attempts with source-backed explanations, retrieve concept briefs, and report content issues for editorial review.

payload.name: Tranmere-Web
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Tranmere-Web helps supporters explore Tranmere Rovers player profiles, matches, results, managerial spells, clubs and transfers, and lets authorised contributors add verified player and transfer records.

payload.name: Fiveable for AP Students
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Study for every AP class with trusted Fiveable content. Find study guides and key terms, retrieve practice MCQs and FRQs, check answers, score written responses with AI feedback, estimate AP scores, review progress, and build personalized study plans. Public course outlines and search work without signing in; connecting a Fiveable account adds saved progress and personalized tools based on the student's Fiveable access.

payload.name: Maakrop
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Maakrop is a teaching assistant that makes everyday classroom management simpler and more convenient. Teachers can access important information and handle common tasks through conversation in one place, without spending time navigating multiple pages, searching through menus, or gathering information manually.

Maakrop can help teachers review teaching schedules, find classes, subjects, and students, check and summarize attendance, review scores, track missing work, and quickly understand what is happening across their classes. It can also assist with tasks such as adding or updating student information, creating assessments, recording scores and attendance, and importing student rosters or teaching schedules.

For tasks involving several steps, Maakrop can gather the relevant information, prepare a clear plan, and present the details for review before any changes are saved. This helps reduce mistakes in repetitive administrative work while keeping teachers informed and in control.

Whether teachers are preparing for the day, checking absences, following up on missing assignments, reviewing class performance, or organizing classroom information, Maakrop reduces the time spent on administration and searching for data. This gives teachers more time to focus on lessons, planning, and supporting their students.

payload.name: Trendkia News
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: TrendKia is a modern, bilingual news desk where trending stories from finance, politics technology, entertainment, reviews, India and the world are caught fast, checked against the facts, and delivered to you in both Hindi and English within minutes.
payload.longDescription: TrendKia 是一个现代化双语新闻台，快速捕捉财经、政治、科技、娱乐、评论、印度及全球热点新闻，核查事实，并在几分钟内以印地语和英语双语提供给你。

payload.name: EduRolia
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: EduRolia is an admissions CRM for private schools, publicly funded schools, and education groups. Connect your account to review the admissions pipeline, identify families that need follow-up, and search authorized students, families, and contacts. Each user can access only the schools allowed by their EduRolia account. The current version is read-only and cannot create, edit, or delete CRM records.

payload.name: AI Voor Leerlingen
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Loop je vast bij aardrijkskunde? AI Voor Leerlingen legt lastige onderwerpen uit op jouw HAVO- of VWO-niveau, stelt gerichte oefenvragen en helpt je stap voor stap verder. Je krijgt geen standaard chatbotantwoord, maar uitleg die aansluit bij je vak, niveau en leervraag — gebaseerd op zorgvuldig samengestelde onderwijsinhoud.
payload.longDescription: 学地理时遇到困难？AI Voor Leerlingen 按照你的 HAVO 或 VWO 学业水平讲解难点，提出有针对性的练习问题，并逐步帮助你进步。你获得的不是标准聊天机器人回答，而是基于精心编制的教育内容，贴合你的学科、水平和学习问题的讲解。

payload.name: Wortschatz
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Use Wortschatz to create personalised flashcard decks, practise vocabulary and translations, and learn any language at your own pace.

payload.name: TTXVN Nghị quyết 57
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: TTXVN Nghị quyết 57 giúp người dùng tra cứu tư liệu TTXVN về việc triển khai Nghị quyết 57, gồm chỉ đạo của lãnh đạo, tin sự kiện, nhiệm vụ và giải pháp, cùng hoạt động triển khai của bộ ngành và địa phương.

payload.name: Analytics Brain
payload.description: 搜索 Witbee 的专家指南
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Analytics Brain connects ChatGPT to Witbee's knowledge base on marketing analytics, tracking and data engineering — webinar write-ups, newsletter issues, procedures and guides written by Witbee's own team.

Ask a question and the assistant searches the library, reads the relevant document in full, and answers with a citation back to the source — so you can verify it and go deeper if you need to.
payload.longDescription:
Analytics Brain 将 ChatGPT 连接到 Witbee 关于营销分析、追踪和数据工程的知识库——包含由 Witbee 自有团队撰写的网络研讨会纪要、通讯各期内容、流程和指南。

提出问题后，助手会搜索资料库，完整阅读相关文档，并在回答中附上来源引证，方便你核实并按需深入了解。

payload.name: Taxiger Doc
payload.description: 了解比利时出租车法规
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: TaxiGer Doc helps taxi operators, drivers and taxi business owners better understand Belgian taxi regulations, legal obligations and administrative procedures for rank taxis, street taxis and limousine services in Flanders, Brussels and Wallonia. Find official Chiron guides, information about the dienststaat, vervoerbewijs, route sheets, taxi licences, inspections and all mandatory taxi documents.
payload.longDescription: TaxiGer Doc 帮助出租车运营商、司机和出租车企业主更好地了解比利时的出租车法规、法律义务，以及弗兰德斯、布鲁塞尔和瓦隆地区的出租车站候车出租车、街头巡游出租车和豪华轿车服务相关行政程序。查找官方 Chiron 指南，以及有关 dienststaat、vervoerbewijs、路线表、出租车许可证、检查和所有强制出租车文件的信息。

payload.name: Uncountable (US)
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Connect your Uncountable workspace to search experiments, formulations, samples, and test results, pull specific measurements, and draft technical write-ups grounded in your own lab data. Access respects your existing Uncountable permissions.

payload.name: ProSchool360
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Connect ChatGPT directly to your ProSchool360 school management account. Easily query and monitor student profiles, academic schedules, homework lists, timetables, and key financial statistics from your school branch using simple natural language prompts.

payload.name: Nyambot
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Nyambot connecte votre assistant à la donnée publique officielle française et rend des réponses sourcées. Posez une question sur l'immobilier (prix DVF réels), le droit (articles Légifrance), les entreprises (registre SIRENE), les aides sociales, la santé ou une démarche : Nyambot va chercher la donnée officielle, la croise et cite ses sources (date, référence, montant). Quand la donnée n'existe pas ou que la question est imprécise, il le dit plutôt que d'inventer.

payload.name: Agent Kunjani
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Agent Kunjani turns a training brief into a ready-to-play deck on Kunjani, a WhatsApp-based, AI-powered game-based learning platform used to train frontline and distributed teams.

Describe who you are training and the behaviour you want to change, and Agent Kunjani designs the learning outcomes and writes the activities across Kunjani's six activity types (the Suits: Jolt, Advance, Mystery, Oops, Explain, Demonstrate), each with a built-in answer key and grading notes for Kunjani's AI grader. It then publishes the finished deck straight into your Kunjani account, where your learners play it on WhatsApp.

You stay in control: it proposes learning outcomes for your approval before writing activities, and you can list your existing decks, edit individual activities and outcomes, or update a deck in place. Connecting requires your own Kunjani account, and the app only ever reads and writes decks your account is authorized to access.
payload.longDescription:
Agent Kunjani 将培训简报转化为可直接在 Kunjani 上游玩的卡组。Kunjani 是一个基于 WhatsApp、由 AI 驱动的游戏化学习平台，用于培训一线及分布式团队。

描述你要培训的对象和希望改变的行为，Agent Kunjani 就会设计学习成果，并按照 Kunjani 的六种活动类型（Suits：Jolt、Advance、Mystery、Oops、Explain、Demonstrate）编写活动，每项活动都内置答案和供 Kunjani AI 评分器使用的评分说明。随后，它会将完成的卡组直接发布到你的 Kunjani 账号，让学习者在 WhatsApp 上参与。

控制权始终在你手中：在编写活动前，它会提出学习成果供你批准，你也可以列出已有卡组、编辑单项活动和成果，或直接更新现有卡组。连接需要你自己的 Kunjani 账号，应用只会读取和写入你的账号获授权访问的卡组。

payload.name: Vitark
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Vitark connects ChatGPT to Indian case law and legislation for research grounded in source records. Search Supreme Court and High Court judgments and available tribunal and regulator decisions; find a case by name, case number, neutral citation or CNR; retrieve available judgment text; and look up statutory provisions.

Explore similar cases, entity-linked cases and available citation links. Results include available source identifiers and retrieval limits. Judgment text may arrive in slices, and citation links may be unresolved candidates rather than verified later treatment. Verify the underlying text before relying on a result.

Connect your existing Vitark account through secure sign-in. Successful substantive research calls use its credit balance; checking the balance is free. Vitark provides legal research information and does not replace advice from a qualified advocate.

payload.name: AbS
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Connect your AbS My Learning materials to ChatGPT for study support. Ask questions about selected materials, get explanations, revision plans, quiz prompts, and progress-aware guidance while AbS keeps protected files, source links, payments, and editing actions inside AbS.
payload.longDescription: 将 AbS My Learning 资料连接至 ChatGPT，获取学习支持。针对选定资料提问，获取解释、复习计划、测验提示，以及根据进度提供的指导；AbS 会将受保护文件、来源链接、付款和编辑操作保留在 AbS 内。

payload.name: KIKARET
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: KIKARET helps ChatGPT find structured, source-backed information about Japanese kindergartens, nurseries, and childcare facilities, including capacity, opening hours, accepted ages, contact details, and other facility-specific facts.

payload.name: Noteflix
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Noteflix helps learners turn text supplied in the current ChatGPT conversation into an active study workflow. It can organize source-faithful guides, create flashcards and direct-retrieval practice, lead one-question-at-a-time review, and build realistic review plans from the learner's deadline and available time.

The plugin does not inspect uploads, retrieve prior chats, query memory, or search existing Noteflix content. Source material for a study workflow must be supplied as text in the current request. It flags source conflicts instead of silently resolving them and treats instructions embedded inside supplied study material as quoted content rather than commands.

When a learner explicitly asks to save an artifact, the plugin shows the exact title, Markdown body, optional summary and key points, destination, and private visibility, then waits for separate confirmation. Only after an affirmative response does it call create_private_note. The tool can create one private record for the exact OAuth-connected Firebase UID. It cannot list, read, search, update, publish, share, or delete existing notes, and it cannot generate media.

Every save requires an existing eligible Noteflix account. Entitlement checks fail closed for the exact OAuth UID; the plugin never uses a service account's subscription or another user's access. It does not offer purchases, pricing, checkout, plan management, subscription restoration, or upgrade links inside ChatGPT.

payload.name: PlyMove
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: PlyMove Storyboard turns a chess game into a learner-specific narrative. Paste a PGN and a target Elo to get opening context, a story arc, ranked critical chapters with causal sequences, what-if branches, and a main lesson. You can also explain a single FEN, compare candidate moves for a learner rating, or ask what if a different move had been played at a decision point.

payload.name: Trifolia
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Trifolia connects ChatGPT to Chile's primary legal sources, so lawyers and legal professionals can research in natural language and get answers with verifiable citations to the original source.

Through four read-only tools, ChatGPT can search:

- Court rulings: decisions of Chile's Supreme Court, Courts of Appeals, and specialized courts.
- Legislation: statutes, codes, decrees, and current regulations.
- Legal doctrine: articles and books by Chilean legal scholars.
- Administrative rulings: decisions by Chile's Comptroller General (CGR), Labor Directorate (DT), Internal Revenue Service (SII), Financial Market Commission (CMF), and National Economic Prosecutor (FNE).

Every answer includes a grounded synthesis and a bibliography of the cited documents with links, so professionals can verify each statement against the primary source. The tools only run searches: they do not modify data or access the user's memory, conversation history, or files.

Trifolia is built for professional legal practice in Chile. It requires a Trifolia account (free sign-up at https://trifolia.cl/register/) with OAuth authentication.
payload.longDescription:
Trifolia 将 ChatGPT 连接到智利的一手法律来源，让律师和法律专业人士可以用自然语言进行研究，并获得指向原始来源、可核验的引证。

通过四种只读工具，ChatGPT 可以搜索：

- 法院裁决：智利最高法院、上诉法院和专门法院的判决。
- 法律法规：法律、法典、法令和现行规章。
- 法律学说：智利法律学者撰写的文章和书籍。
- 行政裁决：智利审计长办公室（CGR）、劳动局（DT）、国内税务局（SII）、金融市场委员会（CMF）和国家经济检察官办公室（FNE）的决定。

每个答案都包含有依据的综合说明，以及附链接的引证文献目录，便于专业人士根据一手来源核实每项陈述。这些工具只运行搜索，不会修改数据，也不会访问用户的记忆、对话历史或文件。

Trifolia 面向在智利从事专业法律工作的人士。需要 Trifolia 账户（可在 https://trifolia.cl/register/ 免费注册）并使用 OAuth 身份验证。

payload.name: Atlarium Habitat Database MCP
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Atlarium helps users explore public habitat data for aquariums and related habitat systems in ChatGPT. It can search species, plants, products, guides, diagnostics, medicines and fertilization references; check compatibility; calculate tank, water chemistry, dosing and equipment estimates; and generate advisory tank and fertilization plans. The app is read-only and does not expose Atlarium accounts, private workspaces, admin APIs or write operations.
payload.longDescription: Atlarium 帮助用户在 ChatGPT 中探索水族箱及相关生态系统的公开栖息环境数据。它可以搜索物种、植物、产品、指南、诊断、药物和施肥参考资料；检查兼容性；计算水族箱、水化学、投加量和设备的估算值；并生成建议性的水族箱及施肥计划。应用为只读，不开放 Atlarium 账户、私人工作区、管理API或写入操作。

payload.name: Vitamarinaweb
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Search the VitaMarinaWeb marine atlas by scientific or common name. Find public species entries and recent marine articles.

payload.name: TestMaker
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: TestMaker lets you create and manage your own study workbooks through ChatGPT. View your existing workbooks and questions, create new workbooks, and add, edit, or delete questions. Use it to organize study material for school tests, entrance exams, professional certifications, and language learning. A TestMaker account is required.

payload.name: Coffeetable
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Coffeetable helps you find your next book 

It brings one specific page from a book’s public preview. ChatGPT finds the page most relevant to what you are looking for and opens it in a focused reading experience.

Experience the author’s actual writing and decide whether the book is right for you.
payload.longDescription:
Coffeetable 帮你找到下一本书。

它会从书籍的公开预览中选取一个特定页面。ChatGPT 找到与你所寻找内容最相关的页面，并在专注的阅读界面中打开。

阅读作者真实的文字，判断这本书是否适合你。

payload.name: GenealogyDirect
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Use GenealogyDirect to get help with family-history research or help others. Prepare actionable research questions, request copies of specific historical documents, discover requests that match your interests or location, submit offers, and review work you posted or joined. Nothing is published or submitted without your explicit confirmation.

payload.name: HadithDB
payload.description: 搜索《古兰经》、经注和圣训

payload.name: Crazy Tongits – Learn & Review

See public bot actions, select cards on a mobile-friendly table, and review visible cards from private or completed hands. Rule lessons support English, Filipino, and Taglish; brand source summaries are currently in English. Our goal is to make Tongits easier to understand for Filipino players through practical, evidence-based learning. No live account access, live human-match move advice, hidden-card guesses, wagering, or redeemable rewards. Independent research about other brands does not imply affiliation or official support.
payload.longDescription: 通过简短课程、专项练习和与机器人私下对战，学习菲律宾纸牌游戏 Tongits。查看机器人公开的出牌操作，在适合移动设备的牌桌上选择牌，并复盘私人牌局或已结束牌局中可见的牌。探索附有来源的菲律宾地方规则指南，其中会明确标出规则差异和信息缺口；练习使用 Crazy Tongits 培训规则，并不涵盖列出的所有变体。搜索关于 Crazy Tongits、Tongits Go、Tongits Star 和 Tongits ZingPlay 的精选来源摘要，并将各品牌和平台分别处理。规则课程支持英语、菲律宾语和 Taglish；品牌来源摘要目前只有英语。我们的目标是通过实用且有证据依据的学习，让菲律宾玩家更容易理解 Tongits。不提供实时账户访问、真人对局中的出牌建议、暗牌猜测、下注或可兑换奖励。对其他品牌进行独立研究并不代表存在关联或获得官方支持。

payload.name: Life in the UK Practice Tests
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Practise for the Life in the UK test — the citizenship test also known as the British citizenship test — without leaving the conversation. Ask to be quizzed and a full 24-question paper opens: official-style questions, single- and multi-answer, scored against the real 18 out of 24 pass mark, with a timer like the actual exam.

Anyone sitting the test for British citizenship or for settlement (indefinite leave to remain) can use it. For the correct answer, an explanation and a memory tip on every question, a free account on lifeintheuk-tests.uk opens up the same result in full.

The public connector cannot change ClassWise data and does not expose student-level records, per-class enrollment counts, enrollment cells by program, grade, or status, grades, attendance, health or medical information, disability or accommodation records, individual-service plans, discipline records, government-issued identifiers, finance or payment records, message content, credentials, authentication or role administration, raw SQL, arbitrary URLs, or platform controls. payload.name: SuperQDA
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
SuperQDA connects your qualitative research workspace to ChatGPT. Access your research projects, documents, codes, and analyses directly in conversation.

- Browse and read all your uploaded documents (PDFs, Word files, transcripts)

payload.name: Clairwave
payload.description: 海洋声学与实时船舶信息
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Clairwave gives ChatGPT grounded ocean-acoustics answers instead of estimates from memory. Ask about any point in the world ocean and the plugin runs propagation physics on Clairwave's platform: parabolic-equation transmission loss along a bearing, sonar-equation detection ranges, and full 3D Bellhop transmission-loss volumes, driven by Clairwave-served bathymetry, seasonal sound-speed profiles and seabed acoustic parameters.

It also covers ships: search live AIS positions by name or MMSI, list vessels near a point, estimate a vessel's radiated-noise source level from its class, speed and dimensions, fetch a photo, open an MMSI-keyed 3D hull model from the open shipshape fleet, and compute the power-summed noise level at a fixed site such as a fish farm or hydrophone.

Every location accepts a place name ("outside Halifax", "Strait of Hormuz") as well as coordinates. Every simulation result carries a replication bundle (sound-speed profile, bottom parameters, bathymetry transect, grid) and a run id whose files are downloadable, plus a link that opens the run visualized in the Clairwave web platform with no sign-in.

Typical uses: sonar and hydrophone planning, marine-mammal noise exposure screening, aquaculture noise monitoring, teaching ocean acoustics, checking a ship's audibility at a receiver, and exploring how season and seabed change propagation. No account is required. Compute calls share a platform-wide budget of about 20 per minute. Results are climatology-based and are not a substitute for in-situ measurements.
payload.longDescription:
Clairwave 为 ChatGPT 提供有依据的海洋声学答案，而非凭记忆估算。询问全球海洋中的任意地点，插件就会在 Clairwave 平台上运行传播物理计算：沿指定方位的抛物方程传输损失、声呐方程探测距离，以及完整的 3D Bellhop 传输损失体积；计算使用 Clairwave 提供的海底地形、水体季节性声速剖面和海床声学参数。

它也支持船舶信息：按名称或 MMSI 搜索实时 AIS 位置、列出某地点附近的船只、根据船舶类别、速度和尺寸估算其辐射噪声源级、获取照片、打开来自开放 shipshape 船队且以 MMSI 为键的 3D 船体模型，并计算鱼场或水听器等固定地点的功率叠加噪声级。

地点既可使用地名（“哈利法克斯外海”“霍尔木兹海峡”），也可使用坐标。每项模拟结果都附带可复现数据包（声速剖面、海底参数、海底地形剖面、网格）和一个运行 ID，其文件可供下载；还提供一个链接，可在 Clairwave 网页平台中打开可视化结果，无需登录。

典型用途：规划声呐和水听器、筛查海洋哺乳动物噪声暴露、监测水产养殖噪声、教授海洋声学、检查接收点是否能听到某艘船，以及探索季节和海床如何改变传播情况。无需账户。计算调用共用全平台预算，每分钟约 20 次。结果依据气候学数据，不能替代现场测量。

payload.name: Padlet
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Padlet is a visual board platform used by teachers, students, and teams to collect, organize, and share content on collaborative boards called padlets. The Padlet app for ChatGPT connects the user's own Padlet account via OAuth so they can work with their padlets directly in conversation.

With this app, users can:
- Create padlets and organize them with sections, layouts, wallpapers, and appearance settings.
- Add, edit, arrange, pin, and sort posts, and draw connections between posts on Freeform boards.
- Read, search, and summarize board content, including AI analysis of images, videos, audio, and document attachments.
- Comment on posts and moderate discussion.
- Manage sharing settings by modifying permissions, passwords, collaborators, and email invitations.
- Schedule automations such as timed freezes, and freeze or unfreeze boards on demand.
- Grade student submissions and sync grades to a connected LMS (e.g. Canvas or Schoology) via LTI.
- For school and team library admins: manage membership and invitations, per-role permissions, SSO configuration (OAuth providers and SAML), approved email domains, content safety, and allowed attachment types.

The app does not yet fully support Padlet's Sandbox (whiteboard) format; it works with Padlet's other board formats.

All actions run against the authenticated user's Padlet account and respect Padlet's permission model — the app can only see and change what the signed-in user could see and change in Padlet itself. Deletions of posts and sections are soft-deletes that can be restored with a dedicated restore tool, and the small number of irreversible operations (deleting comments, automations, or custom fields, removing collaborators, invitations, or approved domains) are annotated as destructive so the assistant confirms with the user before proceeding.

payload.name: RubricMark Practice
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Ask for a practice test, school or university profile, admission score check, writing mark, or flashcards in ChatGPT, Claude, or Gemini (same RubricMark MCP).

For a named exam (HAST, Selective, IELTS, JLPT, GAMSAT, and others), you get three sample questions and a sample mark, plus a link to create a RubricMark account for the timed sit.

Ask about a selective school, grammar school, or QS university — RubricMark returns curated School Guide profiles and first-party links (no invented cutoffs).

Ask whether a Selective, ATAR, SAT, ACT, GAMSAT, LSAT, or GMAT score is competitive — RubricMark opens the Admission Score Estimator with your numbers prefilled. Mapping stays on the site.

Link your RubricMark account to run a full criterion mark on a pasted draft, open a timed sit in the app, and get an improvement plan with next practice, retrieve cards, and learning materials.

Paste a writing draft for a short sample comment without linking. Linked accounts get the quoted report (credits / plan).

Plans and checkout stay on RubricMark. Nothing is sold in the host chat.
